notes: School-level survey results DOH published on data.wa.gov before the WTN workbooks: one dataset per school year and cohort (Kindergarten, Sixth Grade, K-12) for 2014-15, 2015-16 and 2016-17, found through the Socrata catalog (api.us.socrata.com, domains=data.wa.gov, q=immunization) on 2026-09-09. A closed series: nothing was added after 2016-17 and the dataset ids do not change, so each file is fetched once (if_exists = skip) to raw/wa_socrata_<start year>_<k|6th|k12>.csv and parsed into standard/data_schools_2014_2016.csv.gz. The dataset titled 'Sixth (6th) grade immunization data, 2014-2015' (mgne-w2kv) is a copy of the 2014-15 K-12 table (i89p-imif), row for row with the K-12 columns, so there is no sixth-grade table for 2014-15 and it is not fetched. 'Asotin County Immunization Data by School' (jzrz-dku2) is a single-county extract and is not used. url points at the 2016-17 K-12 dataset for the source check.
